title: Creamy Pasta Bake with Scamorza
description: A delicious and comforting pasta dish featuring scamorza cheese, a staple of Croatian cuisine. Earthy mushrooms add depth to this creamy bake.

ingredients.name: Earthy mushrooms (such as cremini or shiitake)

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in cream and bring to a simmer.
Add sliced scamorza cheese and stir until melted.
Combine cooked pasta and mushroom mixture.
Transfer pasta to a baking dish and top with additional scamorza cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
